protocol.sample: Complete UTC days within the January–November 2026 archived deployment-aligned native account
protocol.volatility: Square root of 365 times the mean of the previous seven completed BTC daily log returns squared
protocol.comparison: High means current observation is at least the 80th percentile of the prior 90 observed 7-day volatilities
protocol.outcomes: Cash account daily return, share of days below -2 percent, and within-day peak-to-trough on 5-minute marks including both day boundaries
protocol.scope: Retrospective regime attribution without account replay or weight changes. Contiguous volatility regimes are serially dependent.
